parties: Adani Enterprises Limited (acquirer via subsidiaries Adani Road Transport Limited and Adani Road GRICL Limited) / Path Highway LLP (target)
headline: Adani Enterprises acquires Path Highway LLP through road transport subsidiaries
sum: Adani Enterprises has acquired Path Highway LLP through a dual-subsidiary structure: the wholly owned subsidiary Adani Road Transport Limited (ARTL) and Adani Road GRICL Limited (a step-down subsidiary of ARTL), consolidating highway asset ownership within the Adani Road Transport vertical.
implication: The acquisition exemplifies multi-tier subsidiary acquisition mechanics under the Structures Reorganisation Code to segregate highway concession assets, with potential implications for NCLT classification of the entities and inter-company guarantee frameworks post-acquisition.
detail: Adani Enterprises Limited announced the acquisition of Path Highway LLP through Adani Road Transport Limited (ARTL), its wholly owned subsidiary, and Adani Road GRICL Limited, a step-down subsidiary of ARTL. The transaction consolidates highway assets within the Adani Road Transport vertical. The acquisition was disclosed to the National Stock Exchange on 13 August 2026 as a material event notification. No consideration amount or timeline for completion has been disclosed in the initial intimation.
